subject.title: Feishu: bot does not respond when @-mentioned in a reply message

question: Should maintainers repair/adopt the conflicting cross-repository Feishu candidate or open a fresh narrow target-repository fix for this issue?
rationale: The bug is source-reproducible and still present, but the only exact open candidate is outside the target repo, conflicting, and previously reviewed as needing safer mention and root-routing behavior.

options.title: Repair or replace the candidate
options.body: Use the existing candidate as source context but land a current-main target-repository fix with bot-specific dropped-mention evidence and routing tests.

options.title: Wait on the cross-repo author
options.body: Keep this issue open while asking the author to rebase and address the prior safety concerns in their open fork PR.

options.title: Defer Feishu reply work
options.body: Leave this as an open known bug without creating another repair lane until Feishu maintenance bandwidth is available.

recommendation.title: Repair or replace the candidate
recommendation.body: Use the existing candidate as source context but land a current-main target-repository fix with bot-specific dropped-mention evidence and routing tests.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc is the most recent contributor in the Feishu mention-handling area and is a strong routing candidate for deciding the safe detection shape.
